ambiguous_equivalence_groups.reason: These clips can look similar in a single view, but they are not supervised pair samples because both camera_id and physics_id differ.
ambiguous_equivalence_groups.intended_use: diagnostic/evaluation example; disambiguate with additional same-camera or same-physics pairs.
